title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show bursting with a smoking 'Going Down the Road' and soaring 'Morning Dew', captured on an audience tape of solid but not pristine sound.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this September 17 1982 performance, calling the second set “magic” with standout moments like ‘Going Down the Road’, ‘Morning Dew’, ‘Eyes of the World’, ‘The Other One’ and a blistering ‘Sugar Magnolia’. The recording is an audience‑sourced tape that delivers decent clarity and preserves the show’s crackling energy, though it lacks the polish of a professional soundboard or matrix source.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (mostly 5‑star) highlight an exceptional performance; recording comments note it’s decent but not flawless, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity for an audience tape; some reviewers note it doesn’t match matrix‑level fidelity and may miss some detail in Phil’s bass, but overall the energy comes through.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as marginal, but the second set erupts with intense drums/space, Spanish jam, and Phil’s bomb‑dropping bass leading to a series of high‑impact jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's vocals are highlighted as moving and emotionally resonant; his presence on stage is repeatedly felt throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work is praised as “bombs” that clip speakers, with several reviewers noting his fire‑brand playing in the second set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s vocal reading of ‘Throwing Stones’ is described as raw and intense.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drums receive mention for an intense, spacey segment with a Spanish jam that fuels the explosive second‑set flow.
